ecosystem.notes: The 10-K has no flow measure, so measure is null. Both studies are IDC white papers sponsored by Salesforce and are model-based forecasts, not measured flows. The December 2023 paper estimates new revenue generated for Salesforce customers from AI-powered Salesforce clouds (it also gives $312 billion for 2022, rising to a forecast $948 billion in 2028); the $2.02 trillion is cumulative over 2022–2028. The September 2021 paper is the one that sizes the partner ecosystem itself (add-on apps, IT services, consulting, hardware and more sold around Salesforce), as a ratio to Salesforce's own revenue ($4.96 per $1 in 2021); it has no single money value, so value is null. IDC notes "the ecosystem may include companies that are not formal business partners of Salesforce". Neither study covers FY2025 actuals.
